description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team focused on restoring function and improving the quality of life for patients.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans to help patients achieve their rehabilitation goals. We offer a supportive environment where your skills will be valued, and you can make a significant impact on patient recovery. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited PTA program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
